purpose: Campaign slice 14a — lease reconciliation owned by ds-command-kernel::design_presence. `expected_ts` is the four-step pass of transformer-presence.ts with its lock call RECORDED instead of sent, so the order and the shared budget are observable; recorded by running that code once before deleting it. `expected` is the kernel plan.

cases.note: A saved room drops its hold and its draft: the save transaction already ended both.
A discarded room releases its lease and its draft — but only when the pass saw every room.
A partial refresh saw a subset; releasing on that evidence would drop a lease for a room that is merely off-screen.
A dirty room this browser holds no lease for takes one, anchored to its write time.
The room moved under the lease, so the hold is retaken and the original anchor carried forward.
No digest anywhere: the decision falls through to the staleness clause, and the host is told what it could read.
Nothing moved and the lease is young: no call at all.
The lease is older than HOLD_REFRESH_MS.
Another account holds it and the window has not passed: a moved digest must not jump it.
Another account holds it and the window passed: re-ask.
A room the server does not know can carry no lease.
Twenty holds is the cap, not twenty-one.
The twenty-first hold waits for the next pass and is counted.
ONE budget: twenty holds defer EVERY release, so a vanished room keeps its server lease until a later pass.
Holds are spent first; what the budget leaves goes to the releases.
